notes: 3DBAG merges the left tower into the gable (28 m front wall where the nave gable is 15.6-21.1 m); builder cuts the 9.8 m deep front block out of the shell (shell-carve.ts) and rebuilds towers and gable from the shell's own roof planes (ridge 21.12 m, slope 1.575, drift 0.0125 m/m). Tower centres and caps from 3DBAG cap apexes (t 13.25 and 27.2 along the front, apex 37.3 m); window rows and gable arcade from ref-front.jpg at about 0.0196 m per pixel. Belfry arcade is read from the Commons towers view (5-6 round arches over a stone cornice); inner, side and rear faces repeat it and are inferred. Nave long walls and the north end are inferred blank brick (Bloemstraat elevation is nearly blind per monument 200454 as quoted in the earlier kit). Rear lantern cap is 3DBAG only.
